patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Adobe Marketo Engage documents a broader use-case set; WhatConverts is narrower/specialist.

Adobe Marketo Engage documents a broader use-case set; WhatConverts is narrower/specialist. Choose Adobe Marketo Engage only if your buying job matches “Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM se” rather than WhatConverts's shape. Choose WhatConverts only if your buying job matches “Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking from $30/mo ” rather than Adobe Marketo Engage's shape. Workflow advantage: Adobe Marketo Engage leans marketing-automation, lead-nurturing; WhatConverts leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Adobe Marketo Engage documents a broader use-case set; WhatConverts is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Adobe Marketo Engage is Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM secondary.; WhatConverts is Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking from $30/mo with Plus/Pro/Elite ladders..
- Company-size focus: Adobe Marketo Engage (mid-market, enterprise) vs WhatConverts (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adobe Marketo Engage-leaning marketing-automation, lead-nurturing, inbound-sales vs WhatConverts-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Adobe Marketo Engage — Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency; WhatConverts — Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite.

Limitations — Adobe Marketo Engage: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency; Implementation/ops overhead is enterprise-grade; WhatConverts: Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite; Usage overages can dominate TCO.

Poor-fit cases: Adobe Marketo Engage is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency · WhatConverts is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite · Avoid Adobe Marketo Engage if you actually need WhatConverts's motion (Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking fr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
